provenance.what: adversarial stress test on the corrected exploratory lunar panel
provenance.not: not confirmation; not a new pre-registration; the same data was examined in v1 and v2 first
provenance.panel: artifacts/lunar_sites_v2/lunar_sites_v2.json (baseline re-derived and verified identical before any perturbation ran)
provenance.perturbation_space: supports, footprint_m, centre_shift_m, resampling, border_ring, tail_fraction, array_perturbation, axes, pool
provenance.primary_metric: perturbation-level: stable only if EVERY site x support cell keeps the baseline layer-1 set
provenance.excluded: info_drop_winner:earth_nevada_basin is reported but NOT counted -- removing the winner answers a different question
provenance.scope: map-scale terrain-MORPHOLOGY screening only; a robust verdict is never true and upgrades no traversability, geologic-equivalence, site-access or mission-readiness claim
